annotation.title_clean: Guía para entidades públicas y privadas en materia de Transparencia y Protección de Datos Personales para una Inteligencia Artificial responsable
annotation.title_en: Guide for Public and Private Entities on Transparency and Personal Data Protection for Responsible Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), Argentina
annotation.venue: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública, Buenos Aires
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentina's data protection and access-to-information agency (AAIP) issues a voluntary guide for public and private entities on transparency and personal data protection across the four AI lifecycle stages. It covers risks, Law 25.326 principles, impact assessment, algorithmic transparency sheets, incident handling and data subject rights. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four-stage AI lifecycle recommendations: design, verification and validation, implementation, operation and maintenance
Data protection impact assessment and risk matrix at design stage; privacy by design and by default
Publish a transparency sheet (ficha) for AI systems, label AI-generated content, provide complaint channels and human contact
Publish an ethical commitment record naming responsible roles
Rights to explanation and human review of automated decisions, drawing on Law 25.326, Convention 108+ and a pending data protection bill
